'''Engine maintenance droids''' were large, [[Droid/Legends|droids]] equipped with [[Grasper jaw|grasping mandibles]], [[Laser/Legends|industrial lasers]], and [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]]. One was assigned to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial mining complex|mobile mining operation]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alabash]] under the command of [[Control (droid)|Control]], a [[Terreene Brainiac]] class of [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|artificial intelligence]].<ref name="Freedom" />
